scope: COMMON V2.2 legacy finding revalidation for DRCOM22-001

pdf.visual_note: Page 15 visibly presents two NetexMode choice sections. The PtMainMode/PrivateMainMode choice is marked -1:1 and the public/private submode choice is also marked -1:1 using the documented VDV choice notation.

authority.authority_note: No VDV-301-2.2 release tag is invented. Authority is the exact historical upstream V2.2 file lineage; integration-branch bytes match those exact blobs.

finding.claim: COMMON V2.2 PDF presents both NetexMode one-of groups as mandatory while the exact historical V2.2 XSD declares both top-level xs:choice compositors minOccurs=0.
finding.visual_result: Rendered page 15 visibly confirms -1:1 VDV choice notation for both NetexMode choice groups.
finding.xsd_result: Exact historical Common V2.2 contains two top-level NetexMode xs:choice compositors and each has minOccurs=0.

active_disproof.boundary_effect: The exact XSD accepts a NetexMode with neither a main-mode branch nor a submode branch, exceeding the PDF's visible mandatory one-of presentation.

finding.validation_behavior: material; validation and generated models must follow the selected V2.2 XSD optional compositors and must not impose PDF-only mandatory choice presence
